summary: A United States Army captain whose break with the pre-War military became central to the Brotherhood of Steel's origins.
description: Maxson led soldiers at Mariposa shortly before the Great War. The archive treats his military service, the Mariposa rebellion and the later Brotherhood identity as separately evidenced, time-aware facts.

summary: Roger Maxson's son and a later leader of the Brotherhood of Steel.
The Vault 13 resident sent into the wasteland in 2161 to find a replacement water chip.
A leader of Shady Sands and father of Tandi.
A Shady Sands resident who became a formative political leader of the New California Republic.
A chemist associated with the Mordino family who claimed responsibility for creating Jet.
description: Myron's account is retained as a source statement. Other released material complicates a simple post-War origin for Jet, so the archive does not silently promote his claim into settled world fact.

summary: The founder and autocratic leader of Caesar's Legion in the Mojave conflict.
A founding Legion commander who led its forces during the First Battle of Hoover Dam.
The pre-War industrialist whose systems preserved Las Vegas and who later ruled New Vegas from the Lucky 38.
President of the Enclave during its conflict with the Chosen One in 2242.
A technologically focused military order that emerged from Roger Maxson's followers after the Great War.
description: The Brotherhood developed into geographically separated chapters with differing policies while retaining a shared origin and institutional identity.

summary: The pre-War military organisation in which Roger Maxson served.
The pre-War federal state whose institutions and conflicts shaped the world that preceded the Great War.
A secretive organisation descended from elements of the pre-War United States government.
The pre-War corporation responsible for the Vault programme.
A post-War republic founded from Shady Sands and expanded across parts of California and into the Mojave.
An expansionist autocracy formed from conquered tribes and led by Caesar.
A Brotherhood chapter based in the Mojave Wasteland, centred on Hidden Valley.
A humanitarian organisation devoted to education, medicine and preserving knowledge.
A tribal society descended from earlier Khan groups and active in the Mojave region.
The Master's movement to transform wasteland populations through the Forced Evolutionary Virus.
The underground California bunker that became the Brotherhood of Steel's principal early base.
A pre-War military installation used for Forced Evolutionary Virus experimentation and occupied by Maxson's unit in 2077.
A Vault in southern California and the home from which the Vault Dweller began the water-chip search.
A post-War settlement founded by Vault 15 descendants that became the origin and first capital of the NCR.
A major trading settlement in post-War southern California.
The ruins of Los Angeles and the communities that developed among them.
The real-world dam on the Colorado River that became the focus of conflict between the NCR and Caesar's Legion.
The post-War city centred on the preserved Las Vegas Strip and ruled by Robert House.
The post-War Mojave region containing New Vegas, Hoover Dam and numerous competing communities.
A group of bunkers in the Mojave used by the local Brotherhood chapter.
The offshore installation that served as the Enclave's headquarters until its destruction in 2242.
A Vault near Boston built around a rehabilitation programme that Vault-Tec deliberately sabotaged.
The global nuclear exchange of 23 October 2077 that destroyed pre-War civilisation.
Maxson's break with the United States after discovering human experimentation at Mariposa shortly before the Great War.
The post-War movement of Maxson's group from Mariposa toward the Lost Hills bunker.

displayName: Formation of the Brotherhood of Steel
summary: The gradual adoption of a new identity and order by Maxson's followers after their arrival at Lost Hills.
The Vault Dweller's 2161 expedition to obtain a replacement water chip for Vault 13.
The destruction of the Master's immediate plans and military centres in 2162.
The formal establishment of the New California Republic in 2189.

displayName: Destruction of the Enclave Oil Rig
summary: The destruction of the Enclave's offshore headquarters in 2242.
The 2277 battle in which NCR forces stopped Caesar's Legion at Hoover Dam.
The climactic 2281 confrontation over Hoover Dam; its outcome varies with player choice.
A pre-War viral research programme whose strains caused extensive mutation and shaped several post-War conflicts.
An addictive chem whose origin is represented by conflicting and source-dependent evidence.
A family of powered combat armour developed before the Great War and closely associated with several military factions.
The control component whose failure prompted Vault 13 to send the Vault Dweller into the wasteland.
